article: 気分転換に見返す投稿・動画
scope: Compared all article sections in Japanese and twelve translations; checked the X post text and three current YouTube video titles/authors, section headings, dates, and links.
findings: Removed duplicate future dates, retained original publication date 2022-09-08, and set lastmod to review date.
Reframed the page as a personal selection instead of claiming it reliably improves motivation or has universally beneficial effects.
Aligned the second video heading with the current title, So Takei: A mindset for turning life around; retained translated headings for Narita’s values clip and Miyazaki’s purpose-of-life clip.
Added direct links to the original X post and each YouTube video beside the embeds in every locale.
The X embed metadata returned its caption; direct page access was blocked with HTTP 403 in this environment. YouTube oEmbed returned metadata for all three videos.
